depicts: Split brochure image: landfill garbage pile with orange sky on the left, forest waterfall and pool with ferns on the right, diagonal divider and a green-bordered text panel across the bottom.
text_readable: Readable at native size: "THIS COULD BE THE WORLD'S REALITY IN OUR LIFETIME", "OVER 900,000,000 TREES ARE CUT DOWN EVERY YEAR", "IT TAKES EVERYONE". Body lines are small but legible; the text panel is semi-transparent over the imagery.
composition: Diagonal split runs from top centre-right to bottom centre; text panel spans the lower-left and centre, covering part of the landfill and the split line. Ferns sit at bottom right.
tone_and_contrast: Left half is dark and brown with an orange sky patch; right half is brighter green and teal. Text panel is grey-translucent with white text against a green border.
sharpness_and_artifacts: Landfill side is soft and murky; waterfall side is sharp. Slight compression texture. Text panel background blur shows through. No watermarks or cursors.
scan_first_read: A dirty landfill against a clean waterfall, with a paragraph of text below; the contrast of the two halves reads first.
